```{=html}
<!-- Dark mode switch (docute style). It is moved next to the report title at
     the top of the sidebar, so it takes no space from the report.
     Remembers the reader's choice in this browser; otherwise follows the
     computer's light or dark setting. -->
<button class="theme-switch" id="theme-switch" type="button" role="switch"
        aria-checked="false" aria-label="Dark mode">
  <span class="track"><span class="knob"></span></span>
  <span class="mode-label">Light</span>
</button>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var sw = document.getElementById("theme-switch");
  var stored = null;
  try { stored = localStorage.getItem("hds-theme"); } catch (e) {}
  var prefersDark = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  var theme = stored || (prefersDark ? "dark" : "light");

  function apply(t) {
    var dark = t === "dark";
    root.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
    sw.setAttribute("aria-checked", dark ? "true" : "false");
    sw.querySelector(".mode-label").textContent = dark ? "Dark" : "Light";
    sw.title = dark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode";
  }
  apply(theme);

  sw.addEventListener("click", function () {
    theme = root.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    apply(theme);
    try { localStorage.setItem("hds-theme", theme); } catch (e) {}
  });

  // Once the page has loaded: switch next to the title, logo under the author
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var title = document.querySelector("#sidebar h2");
    if (title) title.appendChild(sw);
    var footer = document.getElementById("postamble");
    var logo = document.querySelector(".report-footer");
    if (footer && logo) footer.appendChild(logo);
  });
})();
</script>
```

```{r missing-figure, fig.height = 4, fig.cap = "Figure 1. Missing values in the key patient columns"}
  ggplot(aes(x = percent, y = column)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = COL_BLUE) +
  labs(x = "Patients with a missing value (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_hds()
```
